mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing paroxetine plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; paroxetine also inhibits CYP2D6 creating bidirectional enzyme inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine adverse effects (tremor, sedation, hyponatremia); obtain baseline ECG and consider alternative antibiotic if QT prolongation risk is high or patient has cardiac risk factors.
